Hit Die: 1d8

Class skills (automated): +1 to Electronic and Mechanical when this Class is added to a character; removed again if the Class is removed.

Class feature: Prototype: once per session, describe a gadget; it works once for a +2 bonus on one roll or one narrative effect the GM approves.
